annotation.title_clean: Position Paper of the People's Republic of China on Regulating Military Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
annotation.title_en: Position Paper of the People's Republic of China on Regulating Military Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Permanent Mission of the People's Republic of China to the UN Office at Geneva (Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China)
annotation.venue: Permanent Mission of China to the UN Office at Geneva website
annotation.summary_en: China's 2021 position paper on regulating military AI applications. It urges prudent, responsible development, compliance with international humanitarian law, human control of weapon systems, accountability, tiered regulation, multilateral rule-making and international cooperation, while opposing hegemony and ideological barriers to technology access.
key_provisions_or_claims: Weapon systems must remain under human control, with human suspension possible at any time
Humans are the final subject of responsibility; establish accountability mechanisms and operator training
New weapons must comply with international humanitarian law
Implement tiered and categorized regulation of military AI and avoid premature use
Multilateral, inclusive rule-making toward a universal international regime; developed countries assist developing ones
